applicable_to: ACM conference proceedings using the standard acmart sigconf format.
notes: Class is auto-fetched by Tectonic at compile time; no bundled class file needed. Affiliation requires a \country field (enforced by recent acmart versions). Citation style: ACM reference format. main.tex's front matter was cross-checked against the official sample-sigconf.tex (acmart package, borisveytsman/acmart) to include the copyright/DOI/ISBN/acmConference block, ORCID-tagged multi-author list, and a full multi-concept CCS classification. Body is a real filled-in illustrative paper (an on-device recommendation reranking adapter), not placeholder text. Needed \usepackage{microtype}, \emergencystretch=2em, and \raggedbottom in the preamble to fully resolve Overfull/Underfull warnings caused by the narrow two-column width -- a real example of the kind of fix the structure/vision checker (Task 7) should be able to apply. Contains 3 real matplotlib-generated figures: a Hit@10-vs-history-length line chart and an added-latency bar chart in Experiments, plus a before/after compatibility-score histogram in Proposed Method illustrating the reranking mechanism itself. ACM_Conference_Template.pdf is a kept compiled reference render, excluded from get_template_files like all PDFs. Verified to compile cleanly with zero Overfull/Underfull warnings.
